title: Ashen Oaths: The Kiln at Varrow
premise: In the Cinderlands, where broken oaths once burned a kingdom, a band of Sworn wanderers is asked to bring a holdfast chieftain's son back from a dead village where a strange fire has been relit.
tone: Bleak, quiet, and humane. Ash, cold, and hard choices, with small kindnesses that matter. Promises have weight.
boundaries: No sexual content. No graphic torture. Harm to children happens off-screen only. Players can ask to fade to black at any time.
rules_digest:
ROLL: 2d6 + stat (stats -1..+3). 10+ full success; 7-9 partial success with a cost, complication, or hard choice offered by the GM; 6- failure, the GM makes a move and the character marks 1 xp. Situational +1 / -1, total capped at +2 / -2. Aid: helper rolls +Heart; 10+ gives +1; 7-9 gives +1 but the helper shares consequences. There is no armor class, no initiative, and no HP; spotlight passes by fiction.
STATS: iron (force, endurance, melee), edge (speed, aim, ranged), heart (courage, persuasion, oaths), shadow (stealth, deceit), wits (noticing, knowledge, craft, embercraft).
MOVES: Face Danger (+fitting stat; 7-9 costs 1 harm, 1 supply, or something left behind). Clash (+iron, or +edge at range; 10+ inflict harm and choose: take none or inflict +1; 7-9 trade harm). Parley (+heart, +shadow if lying; 7-9 they want something first). Read the Ash (+wits; 10+ three questions, 7-9 one; +1 acting on an answer). Make Camp (party spends 1 supply; everyone heals 1 harm; without supply nobody heals and everyone becomes hungry). Resupply (+wits; 10+ gain 2 supply; 7-9 gain 1, or 2 with a complication). Mend (+wits, 1 supply; 10+ heal 2, 7-9 heal 1; once per patient per scene). Embercraft (+wits, 1 supply; small oath-magic; 7-9 choose 1 harm, weaker effect, or something hears; 6- backlash). Swear an Oath (+heart; 10+ take +1 forward; 7-9 the GM reveals an obstacle; fulfilling an oath = 2 xp; breaking one = forsworn). Last Stand (+heart when harm reaches max; 10+ set harm to max-1 and cannot fight until rest or mending; 7-9 out of the scene with a lasting scar; 6- dying unless mended at 10+ this scene).
HARM: track 0..max (max normally 6), starts at 0 and rises; never below 0 or above max. Harm 1 = scrape, fall, or cold; 2 = blade, arrow, or bite; 3 = crushing blow, fire, or monster. Armored items reduce each harm by 1 (minimum 1) with -1 on Face Danger for speed or stealth. NPCs use the same track and are defeated at their max.
SUPPLY: integer >= 0, starts at 3; spent by moves and freely shareable. At 0 a character cannot Mend or use Embercraft.
CONDITIONS: hungry (-1 all rolls until fed), shaken (-1 heart until a quiet scene), forsworn (-1 heart, distrusted), burned (1 harm unhealable until two camps), scars (permanent, descriptive).
GM MOVES on a miss: inflict harm, take supply, separate them, reveal an unwelcome truth, show a threat approaching, put someone in danger, offer an opportunity with a cost, turn the move back on them, advance a hidden plan. End with "What do you do?"
ADVANCEMENT: at 5 xp reset to 0 and take +1 to a stat (max +3), a new talent, or +1 supply after each Make Camp.
setting_summary: The Cinderlands: thirty winters after the High Hearth broke, every oath sealed by its flame turned to fire and burned the old kingdom. Survivors live in holdfasts and still swear careful oaths before small fires; oath-keeping wanderers are the Sworn. Garrow's Rest is a walled holdfast of about 200 in a burned abbey, ruled by Thane Ysolde Kett; guest-peace is sworn before its Common Fire. Nearby: Ashwater Ford, the Blackwood (ash-wolves), and Varrow Kiln, a dead village where oath-tablets were fired. Factions: the Hold, the rumored Kiln-Born, and the wandering Ash Pilgrims. Trade is in supply, not coins. Time is counted from first frost; play starts at dusk on Day 12 of Frost.
conventions:
character / npc data: appearance (one visual sentence: sex, age, build, hair, face, clothing); path; stats {iron, edge, heart, shadow, wits} (integers -1..3); harm {current, max} (current 0..max, max normally 6); supply (integer >= 0); bonds [strings]; oaths [strings]; talents [strings]; conditions [lowercase strings]; xp (integer). NPCs may use only harm, tags [strings], attitude, conditions. Never add hp, ac, or coins.
item data: quantity (integer >= 0), description, tags [strings] such as "armored" or "ranged". Inventory = items whose parent is the holder.
location data: description; map (see World map).
scene data: status ("active" | "ended"); participants_ids [ids]; initiative [] (unused); turn_of_id (spotlight or null); round 0; time (e.g. "Day 12 of Frost, dusk"); pending_decision.
quest data: status ("open" | "completed" | "failed"); objectives [strings]; giver_id; reward.
event data: due (in-world time), description. faction/relationship data: attitude, notes. Storylines: each active scene is one storyline; scene data also has main (true for the main storyline), time_min (integer in-world minutes since Day 1 00:00, kept in step with time) and busy_until_min (long action in progress). World map: every location has data.map {cols, rows, cell_ft, features [{kind, label, x, y, w, h, to}]} (exits have to: the location they lead to; hidden terrain in gm_notes.map_features); every character and npc has data.pos {x, y, size} on the map of the place it is in (secret ones in gm_notes.pos).
character_creation: Follow the Ashen Oaths Character Creation steps: (1) name and one distinctive feature; (2) choose a path (Blade, Shade, Speaker, Ember-Keeper) and record its talent; create its starting gear as child item records; (3) assign +2, +1, +1, 0, -1 among iron, edge, heart, shadow, wits; (4) harm {current: 0, max: 6}, supply 3, xp 0, conditions []; (5) one bond with each other player character and one with an NPC; (6) one personal oath. No dice are rolled at creation.
house_rules: Shared fire: when the party Makes Camp in a holdfast that has granted them guest-peace, it costs no supply.
provisional_ruling_policy: When no move covers a situation, choose the closest move or call for Face Danger with the fitting stat, label it "provisional ruling" in the narration, and record it in gm_note so the owner can confirm or correct it.
starting_situation: Dusk, Day 12 of Frost, in Garrow's Rest. The characters have just sworn guest-peace before the Common Fire. Thane Ysolde Kett asks them to swear an oath to bring home her son Edric, who went to see the lights at Varrow Kiln three nights ago. His friend Wenna, who came back alone and shaken, sits nearby. The Thane offers 4 supply each, winter shelter, and her bond.
